scope: Official complete pipeline on identical clipped original Claim1+Claim27; not full patent and not old partial AST records or diagnostic smoke

predicates.statement: The Registration Module provides functionality for registering an external recommender with a recommendations service.
predicates.edge_success: A parsed or merged relation explicitly supports module-mediated registration of an external recommender with the service. Endpoints may be Module–External Recommender or Module–Recommendations Service if the full registration predicate is faithfully retained in its description.
predicates.node_success: A Registration Module entity description explicitly retains the same registration capability.

predicates.statement: The same Registration Module allows a provider of an external recommender to provide machine readable descriptions of that recommender.
predicates.edge_success: A parsed or merged relation explicitly supports module-mediated allowance for the provider to provide machine-readable descriptions. Module–Provider is valid if its description retains the complete function; a fixed Module–Descriptions endpoint pair is not required.
predicates.node_success: A Registration Module entity description explicitly retains the same allowance and machine-readable-description object.
predicates.control_note: R2 is fully and explicitly stated in Claim27, which remains intact in a B chunk; R2 alone is a self-contained positive control, not a relationship requiring cross-Claim inference.

primary_joint_criterion: Report R1 and R2 node retention and edge retention separately. Joint technical co-retention succeeds when both supported predicates remain linked to the same actual Registration Module graph identity after merge; preserve actual node IDs and distinguish semantic aliases from a real node merge. Do not require one invented edge connecting registration to descriptions.
legal_dependency_secondary: Score an explicit Claim27→Claim1 dependency edge only if actual graph Claim entities and an explicit dependency relation exist. Its absence may be default ontology/representation scope, not technical relation loss. Claim27 contains the words The system of claim1 in both conditions.
identity_rule: Semantic retention is separate from graph identity. Joint endpoint co-retention requires actual same RegistrationModule graph node ID supporting both predicates; aliases are reported and not silently equated as merged. A description mentioning the module without an actual endpoint is text support, not proof of graph connectivity.
raw_and_parser: Check actual raw relation/entity rows and official imported parser records; no AST substitute. Truncated extraction sample excluded from clean paired comparison and still descriptively inventoried.
retrieval: Check complete target clauses, full Claim1/Claim27, and explicit The system of claim1 dependency wording in natural chunks. Forced evidence is separate.
